description: Solve a CAPTCHA or bot challenge and get a ready-to-use solution. USD 0.000139/call–0.004583/call, **charged per successful solve; failed or empty attempts leave no final charge (anything reserved is restored)**. Use it when a target site is blocked by Turnstile / reCAPTCHA / hCaptcha / a Cloudflare challenge page / GeeTest and the like. Params differ per type — check them with everyinfra_list_captcha_types first.

params.description: Params for that type, e.g. {"website_url":"https://…","website_key":"0x…"}. ⚠ A few types need your own proxy: they deliver a cookie bound to the IP the challenge was solved from, so a solution from our exit IP would not work for you

type.description: CAPTCHA type, e.g. turnstile / recaptcha_v2 / image

name: everyinfra_solve_captcha
title: Solve a CAPTCHA
